decision_rule.close_vllm42: close only if every one of 78 cells holds, all fatal guards hold, and held-out cells are scored after the committed non-held-out publication
decision_rule.fatal_guards: any conservation, identity, pricing, frozen-input, preservation, or chronology violation makes the run VOID and leaves VLLM-42 open
decision_rule.per_cell: the observed amortized batching-service field must lie inside its inclusive frozen band
decision_rule.refutation: publish every miss without widening; keep VLLM-42 open and register the predictor residual on VLLM-50
decision_rule.settled_claims: the 210 to 220 requests per second onset and the 250 to 8,000 requests per second monotonic direction remain preserved and unscored
decision_rule.unscored_fields: arrival-to-prefill wait and handoff-to-decode admission wait are published diagnostics and conservation inputs, not service-band scores

holdout.disclosure_order: publish and commit all non-held-out verdicts before running or scoring any held-out cell
holdout.union_rule: a cell is held out when its load or pool ratio is held out

arrival_schedule.rule: request i arrives at cell start plus i times floor(10^12 divided by offered requests per second)

prefill_and_handoff_source.relationship: frozen before VLLM-41 and independent of its observed curves

physical_bounds.ceiling_derivation: maximum measured interpolated S(b) divided by b for b from one through eight
physical_bounds.floor_derivation: minimum measured interpolated S(b) divided by b for b from one through eight

derivation.arrival: a_i equals i times floor(10^12 divided by lambda)
derivation.decode_grant: the next legal driver in prefill-then-decode round-robin order takes at most eight ready requests
derivation.decode_release: a decode grant of size b advances the shared clock by measured interpolated S(b); nonterminal requests retain queue order for their next token visit
derivation.handoff_completion: decode eligibility is prefill completion plus the independently frozen handoff service
derivation.prefill_completion: a ready prefill batch advances the shared clock by the independently frozen prompt service
derivation.service_projection: sum central S(b_j) over predicted decode grants j and divide by 64 times four request-token visits

old_model_refutation_mechanism.causal_effect: removing those positive delays grants decode before some external arrivals are ready, so transition cells contain fewer requests per decode batch
old_model_refutation_mechanism.locality: away from a discrete batch transition, the added phase does not change batch membership and the service projection is unchanged
old_model_refutation_mechanism.omitted_term: the old batching-service component predictor made prefill and handoff zero-time boundaries
old_model_refutation_mechanism.signed_bias: smaller batches raise service per request-token, so the old predictor is biased high where the omitted phase changes batch membership

surface_uncertainty.rule: scale only the decode service clock by plus or minus three times the maximum independent trimmed coefficient of variation; price every scenario batch with central S(b)

preservation.selection_rule: every tracked examples/pd_session* path except this successor study
